Portrait Frame - Environmental Portrait.description:
🖼️ Portrait Framing: Environmental Portrait
A full-body portrait with more room for the selected surroundings. One character remains the focus.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Frame - Environmental Portrait.traitNarrativeEffects: Vertical environmental character portrait. Show exactly one complete head-to-toe figure at approximately 50–60 percent of canvas height, with clear space above the highest established anatomy and ground beneath the feet or equivalent body support. Keep every established limb, garment and selected prop inside the canvas. Allow the selected setting to remain legible around the figure, while the face and silhouette remain readable. Do not crop to a headshot or upper body, add other characters, split the image into panels, or create a decorative frame, card, border or interface.
